title: Practice 3: об-: around — из-: all over

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.context: обойти́** — **обходи́ть — to go around, to bypass (to pass by going around); to walk through, to wander around, to go around, to tour, to go to (many places in an area).
